source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 · lesson 27. Exercises reused from the lesson; du'aas flagged for review.
topic: Before bed, on the right side, and waking for Fajr

learn.en: Before lying down, shake out your blanket. Blow gently into your cupped hands, recite Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas, and wipe your hands over your body three times.
learn.title: Before you lie down

learn.en: Lie on your right side with your right hand under your cheek, and say the sleeping du'aa.
learn.title: On your right side

learn.en: Don't sleep on your stomach, and don't cover your face so you can breathe well.
learn.title: Face uncovered

learn.en: Go to bed early so you can wake up for Fajr on time — and praise Allah when you wake up.
learn.title: Early to bed
learn.ar: الحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
learn.tr: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi lladhī aḥyānā baʿda mā amātanā wa ilayhi n-nushūr

words.en: Going to bed: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live

quiz.en: True or false? I must sleep on my stomach.
True or false? I must sleep on a clean bed.
True or false? It's OK to cover my face with the blanket.
True or false? I recite Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas before sleeping.

think.q: Tonight, can you recite the three surahs and sleep on your right side?
think.a: Bedtime routine: three surahs, right side, the du'aa, then sleep!

parents.summary: Sleeping manners: the three surahs, right side, face uncovered, the du'aas for sleeping and waking, and early bed for Fajr.

try.en: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live

parents.tip: Do the bedtime routine together tonight.
